snippet.title: Crispy Cheesy Smashed Potatoes
snippet.description:
Golden, crunchy, and loaded with melted mozzarella! 😍 These Crispy Cheesy Smashed Potatoes are soft and fluffy inside with irresistibly crispy cheese edges. Made with just a few simple ingredients, they’re perfect as a snack, appetizer, or side dish. Serve them with your favorite garlic mayo sauce for dipping!

🥔 Ingredients

* 5 small potatoes (350–400 g)
* 150 g shredded mozzarella cheese
* ½ tsp paprika
* ½ tsp smoked paprika
* ½ tsp garlic powder
* ½ tsp salt
* ¼ tsp black pepper
* ½ tsp chili flakes
* Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)

👩‍🍳 Instructions

1. Boil the Potatoes: Wash and boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–20 minutes, until fork-tender. Drain well.
2. Prepare the Cheese: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange half of the shredded mozzarella into 5 small piles.
3. Smash and Season: Place one boiled potato on each cheese pile and gently flatten with the bottom of a glass. Sprinkle with all the seasonings.
4. Add More Cheese: Top each potato with the remaining shredded mozzarella.
5. Bake Until Crispy: Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 20–30 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with garlic mayo sauce.

Ngambil minyak di laut kan tinggal bawa kapal terus ngebor? Ternyata gak segampang itu 🤔

Di video ini kamu bikin tambang minyak lepas pantai dari nol, terus cari tau masalahnya satu-satu.

🛢️ Kapal goyang, pipa bor patah → bikin anjungan: rangka baja (jacket) dipaku ke dasar laut
🛢️ Lubang bor runtuh → dipasang pipa baja (casing) terus dicor semen
🛢️ Minyak nyembur & kebakar → lumpur pemboran yang berat + katup raksasa BOP
🛢️ Kaki anjungan keropos → cat tebel + anoda korban yang "dimakan" karat duluan
🛢️ Minyaknya makin dikit → injeksi air laut buat ngedorong minyak dari pori-pori batu

Di dalem sumur, di kaki anjungan, atau di lapisan minyaknya. Beda tempat, beda penyebab. Habis ini, mau kita bongkar apa? Tulis di komen 👇

snippet.title: Kal Gaon Chalte Hain 😍 | Biwi Ki Packing Dekh Kar Pati Shocked 😱 |#shorts #viral
snippet.description:
Neha soch raha hu kal gaon chalte hain! Sach me gaon ghumne? Haan kuch din wahan rahenge!
Arre wah abhi se packing shuru karti hu! Itni jaldi? Gaon jana hai koi pados me thodi jana hai!
Neha itna saara samaan? Ye sab zaruri hai! Hum sirf 4 din ke liye ja rahe hain! Toh kya 4 din ek hi kapde pehnu? Main toh bas 2 jodi kapde le ke chal raha hu! Tumhe toh kuch samajh hi nahi aata 😂

Rohit batao ye dress le jaun ya ye wali? Dono le jao! Aur agar wahan photo khichwani hui toh? Toh teesri bhi rakh lo! Achha tum mazak uda rahe ho? Nahi madam main toh bas suitcase bacha raha hu!

Raste ke liye chips, biscuit aur chocolate rakh do! Itna sab raste me khaogi? Haan aur cold drink bhi chahiye! Gaon ja rahe hain ya picnic par? Dono samajh lo 😋

Chalo samaan gadi me rakh diya! Ruko mera makeup bag reh gaya! Ek aur bag? Haan ye sabse zaruri hai! Gadi me ab jagah kahan hai? Tum thoda adjust kar lo!

Neha baitho ab! Ek minute! Phone kahan hai? Haath me hi toh hai! Achha aur meri sun glass? Wo sir pe lagi hai! Tum har baat par haste kyu ho? 😂

Rohit gaana lagao na! Kaun sa? Mera favourite! Kaun sa favourite? Arre tumhe itna bhi nahi pata? Achha ab toh raste se zyada mushkil safar lag raha hai!

Rohit gadi roko mujhe kuch khana hai! Abhi toh ghar se snacks khaye the! Wo toh raste ke liye the! Ye yahan ke liye hain! Kya khaogi? Samose, chai aur jalebi! Thik hai madam 😍

Rohit meri achhi photo khicho! Khich di! Ye kaisi aayi hai? Meri aankhen band hai! Ab dusri! Thoda neeche se lo background bhi aana chahiye! Photo khich raha hu ya film bana raha hu? 😂

Rohit dekho kitna sundar gaon hai! Haan yahan aakar bahut achha lag raha hai! Mujhe kheton me ghumna hai aur dher saari photos leni hai! Pehle ghar pahunch jayen phir ghumne chalenge! Pakka? Bilkul pakka!

Rohit mujhe aangan me charpai pe baithna hai! Pehle samaan toh andar rakh lu! Aur shaam ko kheton me ghumane bhi le jana! Haan zarur! Aur raat ko chhat par baithkar chai piyenge! Tumne toh pura tour plan bana liya!

Rohit yahan aakar bahut achha lag raha hai! Mujhe bhi! Shehar ki bhagdaud se thoda aaram milega! Bilkul! Aur mere liye gaon wali jiya bhi kharidna! Abhi se farmaishe shuru 😂
